signal: Laurel raised a $100M Series C (IVP, GV) in 2025 to scale its AI time platform across professional services

email.body1:
Emil, saw Laurel closed its $100M Series C led by IVP to push the AI time platform deeper into professional services.

Scaling that fast usually means more firms in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Laurel off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Emil, quick follow-up for Laurel.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Laurel needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Emil, last bit of proof for Laurel.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Laurel's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Emil, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a professional-services motion? I will tailor it to Laurel either way.
